propositions: Provider construction logic is inline and scattered in runner.py:268 with provider-specific branches, making new providers require surgery to run()
Client lifecycle (httpx.AsyncClient and other closeables) lacks a unified ownership model and is currently managed via ad-hoc tuple returns and finally blocks
pydantic-ai's infer_model hook accepts provider_factory but rebar has no supported contract to use it, forcing workarounds like infer_provider patching
Moving provider construction to a ProviderSession object with a builder registry and centralized closeables tracking will enable new providers (Bedrock, OpenAI-compatible) as additive registrations
The existing Anthropic builder and retry behavior must remain unchanged and be relocated verbatim into the new providers module without behavior modification
